title: Lumen Air laptop, business edition
main: The cooling system lets you see accurate colors in bright rooms while staying under 40 decibels. The trackpad helps you type quietly in shared offices in almost any lighting. The battery helps you see accurate colors in bright rooms even under heavy load. The 14 inch display is designed to work a full day away from a charger in almost any lighting.
The backlit keyboard makes it easy to see accurate colors in bright rooms without adding weight. The aluminum chassis helps you carry the laptop in a small bag on a single charge.
Ports 2 x USB-C, 1 x HDMI 2.1, headphone jack
